About

Turning data into
decisions

I'm a final-year B.Tech student at Manipal University Jaipur, specialising in Computer Science with a focus on Data Science and AI. My work spans machine learning pipelines, computer vision systems, and wearable hardware — with two granted patents to show for it.

I've led national-level events as Student Organiser for SIH 2023 & 2024 Grand Finales and served as Convener for ICIDS 2025 and Co-Convener for ICIDS 2024 — conferences that shaped my understanding of both technical depth and collaborative execution.

Currently exploring opportunities in Germany for a Master's or industry role in AI/ML. I bring hands-on experience with GCP, Gemini, and full-stack ML deployment — and the ambition to keep building things that matter.
